SYS:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** The skill assumes a frontier conductor; Opus/Sonnet-class conductors need gates that fire in code, measured competence, an owned verification spine, and debates that stop re-litigating settled ground.
**Decision:** Root of the altitude tree; owns US-0..US-16.
**Evidence:** spec-final.md v9.1 (sha 5d981350), accepted 2026-07-21
**Next:** Subsystem verification rolls up here; completion blocks on the Phase 8 verification subflow.
SS-W0:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Every G1/G2/G5 mechanism needs the same primitives: strict envelopes, durable transactions, receipts, predicates, authority clients. Building them per-feature would fork failure semantics (the existing 7-phase gauntlet drift is the cautionary tale).
**Decision:** 11 middleware candidates (MW-001..011) land 1:1 as components.
**Evidence:** target-architecture.md §Middleware Candidates; concerns RC-2/RC-3/SEC-1/CB-1
**Next:** All three feature streams consume these components.
SS-A:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Honor-system gates and 90K-token phase docs fail non-frontier conductors silently.
**Decision:** Gate inventory, hook dispatcher, judgment corpus, competence harness, spine units, waiver flow, bootstrap.
**Evidence:** spec §3, §5-§7; concerns DD-2/DD-3/OP-1/SEC-4/FM-1
**Next:** A measured conductor + mechanized gates make Phase 8 safe to run at lower model tiers.
SS-B:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** A hardened session must be structurally unable to complete with unrun critical-seam evidence.
**Decision:** TMR obligation fields, verification cards, evidence write-back, promotion gate with authority-committed prepare/commit, ConOps walkthrough, spine artifacts, contract probes, regime lifecycle.
**Evidence:** spec §8-§11, §18; core concern RC-1 (15 concerns, all six personas)
**Next:** Completion gate becomes mechanical; deferrals become authority-committed facts.
SS-C:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Converged sections get re-litigated and convergence can be claimed falsely (4 live instances this session).
**Decision:** Node registry, freeze seam, deterministic reconciliation, executable quorum + press, critic output contract.
**Evidence:** spec §10, §12; concerns DD-1/DD-4
**Next:** Rounds shrink to the volatile surface; false convergence is structurally rejected.
W0-1:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Nothing else can land without the package skeleton and the ecosystem-policy Python floor.
**Decision:** Scaffold hardening/, pin rfc8785/cryptography, wheel-install test; preserve the adversarial_spec symlink bridge.
**Evidence:** target-architecture §Package and Component Boundaries
**Next:** Unblocks every W0 component.
W0-2:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Ad-hoc JSON reads let malformed or replayed artifacts pass as empty-success; sets hashed in array order collide semantically (CB-2).
**Decision:** One codec for envelopes, JCS, profiles, discriminated authorization facts, canonical_set with duplicate REJECTION.
**Evidence:** spec §1; gauntlet theme CB-2; DF-1 byte-level suite
**Next:** Every artifact consumer validates through one path.
W0-3:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Divergent CLI parsing/exit semantics made failure success-shaped before (CON-006 timeout drift is the pattern).
**Decision:** Shared strict argparse + one result envelope + exit mapping 0/1/2.
**Evidence:** target-architecture §CLI Boundary; INV-016
**Next:** All new CLIs (gate_inventory, bootstrap, harness) inherit one contract.
W0-4:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Coupled multi-file writes (freeze snapshot+event log, registry+evidence) currently have no transaction; concurrent runs lose updates (CON-003/CON-004 class).
**Decision:** Leases, canonical lock order, PREPARED/PUBLISHING/COMMITTED with roll-forward recovery, transaction-corrupt quarantine.
**Evidence:** gauntlet theme RC-3; DF-6 completeness matrix
**Next:** Every coupled write in the slice runs through this coordinator.
W0-5:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** A final-component symlink check is insufficient — intermediate-directory substitution escapes the session root (US-1 theme).
**Decision:** Descriptor-relative walk with per-step O_NOFOLLOW+fstat; lock-capability probe at bootstrap.
**Evidence:** spec §1 descriptor-relative traversal; TC-1.5; DF-8
**Next:** Session-root path safety for every artifact consumer.
W0-6:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Journals are the tamper-EVIDENCE layer; without external anchoring a full-chain rewrite is invisible (SEC-3).
**Decision:** Generic chained append + chain verification + head-anchor emission.
**Evidence:** spec §1.1, §10.2; TC-12.3
**Next:** Node-registry event log and operation journal build on it.
W0-7:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Cryptographic validity is NOT authorization — a minor-gate key must never authorize a critical-seam promotion (SEC-1 confused-deputy).
**Decision:** Exact-byte ed25519 verification THEN purpose-scoped TrustPolicy; chained purpose-preserving rotation.
**Evidence:** spec §1.1; TC-15.8; DF-2/DF-4
**Next:** Waiver flow and authorization snapshots consume it.
W0-8:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** The five-condition prose predicate was paraphrased differently at each consumer — weaker at two sites (CB-4).
**Decision:** Pure typed predicates: is_promotion_ready (6 conditions), is_obligation_satisfied (explicit disjuncts, null-seam precondition), select_for_verification.
**Evidence:** spec §8.1/§9; TC-8.9 mutants; DF-5
**Next:** Cards, roadmap views, and completion all call these by name.
W0-9:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Predicates consuming caller-assembled receipt sets enable mixed-generation and curated-set attacks (SEC-1).
**Decision:** One builder validates receipts against one registry generation into an immutable ValidatedAuthorizationSet with the exact authorization_set_hash formula.
**Evidence:** spec §1/§1.1; INV-020; DF-4
**Next:** promotion_gate and waiver acceptance consume snapshots only.
W0-10:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** After a crash, never-attempted vs response-lost was undecidable — blind retry or false completion (RC-2).
**Decision:** Intent-durable pre-dispatch records; -not-attempted derivation from record absence; same-bytes retry only.
**Evidence:** spec §9 operation journal; TC-8.12; DF-11
**Next:** RemoteAuthorityClient refuses recoverable mutations without an intent.
W0-11:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Local wall-clock rollback could extend remote validity; capability states were unmapped (CB-1).
**Decision:** Offline attestation verification + monotonic authority-time watermark + deterministic capability-state tokens.
**Evidence:** spec §1 trusted time, §5.2 matrix; TC-3.3
**Next:** Bootstrap and regime checks stay hermetic yet honest.
W0-12:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Remote results were exception-shaped or collapsed into advisory success; presence probes proved nothing (SEC-5).
**Decision:** Typed §5.2 result tokens, signed challenge-response + negative probes, behavior-fingerprint pinning, OR-4 recovery split.
**Evidence:** gauntlet theme CB-1; TC-8.11; DF-3
**Next:** The only path to snapshot/prepare/commit/status.
W0-13:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Two writers on one registry without CAS lose updates; sole-writer was aspirational prose (DD-3).
**Decision:** One transaction API (revision CAS, same-txn evidence invalidation) + static lint failing outside write-open call sites.
**Evidence:** spec §8.1 registry transaction API; DF-7
**Next:** Both mutation-kind owners (B-3, B-4) route through it.
W0-14:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** US-4 is the meta-fix: every security fact names ONE authority; consumers were free to branch on mirrors.
**Decision:** Matrix-driven tests per §1.2 row + undeclared-authority lint.
**Evidence:** spec §1.2; gauntlet theme US-4; DF-9
**Next:** Structural guarantee the RC-1/SEC/FM fixes stay fixed.
W0-15:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Phase 4 published on design-walkthrough evidence only; the executable adverse suite was explicitly deferred to this plan (header obligation).
**Decision:** All R4 mandatory cases + 13 R5 additions as executable tests over the real substrate.
**Evidence:** target-architecture §Dry-run Summary; residual_phase7_obligation header
**Next:** Discharges the Phase 4 publication debt with executed-boundary proof.
A-1:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Honor-system gates: no inventory, no classification, unmapped MUST markers (US-1).
**Decision:** gates.json with 3-way classification, violation_modes, doclint marker mapping, negative-test harness; hosts the authoring-lint family.
**Evidence:** spec §5.1; TC-1.0/1.2
**Next:** BOOT-GATES and every mechanized-gate claim depend on it.
A-2:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Parallel hooks with no dispatcher ownership + three drifted role resolvers (CON-005) = unverifiable enforcement (DD-2).
**Decision:** One dispatcher per event, typed verdicts, duplicate-handler detection, conformance fixtures across hook and skill validators.
**Evidence:** spec §5.2 hook-plane; TC-2.4
**Next:** Preventive gates become verified properties.
A-3:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Judgment gates without rubrics are vibes; fixtures double as harness items (US-3).
**Decision:** rubrics/<gate_id>.md + golden fixtures + schema validator.
**Evidence:** spec §5.3; TC-3.0/3.2
**Next:** BOOT-HARNESS validates; A-4 scores against these.
A-4:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** v2's allowed-only rule let empty answers pass any fixture; baselines without environment fingerprints compare apples to oranges (OP-1).
**Decision:** Strict-JSON scoring, exact arithmetic, retry-with-evidence, immutable identity-keyed baselines, waivable pre-session gate (MAX_PHASE_REGRESSION_POINTS=10, OR-6).
**Evidence:** spec §7; TC-6.4/6.5; DF-12
**Next:** Candidate conductors are measured before live sessions.
A-5:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** 90K-token phase docs force load-everything; 09-verification.md contradicts the canonical 8-phase order (CON-002/FIND-002).
**Decision:** spine.md + reference units with single-owner pointer closure; 09 content moves under the Phase 8 tree (OR-3).
**Evidence:** spec §6.1/§6.2; TC-4.x/5.x
**Next:** Workers load exactly what a step needs; B-11 completes the lifecycle fix.
A-6:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Raw JSONL edits could mint waivers; a gate-only grant replays across blocks (SEC-4).
**Decision:** Challenge-bound issuance, bridge-signed nonce consumption, authorization_kind precedence, non-waivable class, idempotent recovery by operation_id.
**Evidence:** spec §5.4; TC-15.4/15.7; DF-14
**Next:** One override style for every blocking gate.
A-7:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** New maintainers had no ready/degraded/broken signal; regime branch was undecidable from artifact absence (FM-1).
**Decision:** BOOT-GATES/HARNESS/RECON/REGISTRY/SPINE blocking + advisory ROUTER; hermetic split; --live-preflight; deferred-state exit mapping.
**Evidence:** spec §3; TC-0.x/TC-2.3
**Next:** The merge point proving five streams integrate; US-0's front door.
B-1:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** The promotion gate binds obligations by revision/policy/hash — none of the three fields exists in the keystone or tmr_schema.py (verified grep=0). 11 tests-spec SCHEMA GAPs carry on them.
**Decision:** Edit shared-context/test-maturity-record-schema.md FIRST, then mirror with schema_sha256 tripwire.
**Evidence:** spec §5.4 tmr_record_hash projection; keystone convention (GLOSSARY)
**Next:** Unblocks predicates (W0-8), registry writer (W0-13), cards (B-2).
B-2:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** The v2 card key minted duplicates on every registry change; board upserts without idempotency duplicate on lost responses (RC-3).
**Decision:** Deterministic key (session, tmr_uid, obligation_revision, obligation_policy_version); registry_hash as provenance; authority-query recovery.
**Evidence:** spec §8.1; TC-7.4; DF-7
**Next:** Phase 8 verification subflow walks these cards.
B-3:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Card completion without registry update counted as promotion-ready before; nothing could lawfully mature TMRs (deadlock).
**Decision:** record_verification_evidence.py validates bindings then atomically writes evidence + nl|acceptance→concrete via W0-13.
**Evidence:** spec §8.1; TC-8.4
**Next:** The only path from a green card to promotion-eligible state.
B-4:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** critical_seam:null blocked promotion with no defined path out; defaulting to false would silently drop critical seams.
**Decision:** Extend the existing classifier (sole writer today): decision records for false, receipt-bound operator resolutions, never-default-false.
**Evidence:** spec §8.1; TC-7.5
**Next:** Unresolved seams get a lawful resolution path.
B-5:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Enforcement at finalize would deadlock (evidence comes later); a quantifier over critical_seam=true lets null records escape (CONS-F6).
**Decision:** Finalize checks registry+plan only; completion gate quantifies critical_seam != false; JCS intent binds the complete §9 field list.
**Evidence:** spec §9; TC-8.2/8.3; gauntlet theme RC-1
**Next:** B-6 dispatches this intent; the completion gate becomes mechanical.
B-6:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** THE core gauntlet finding (RC-1, 15 concerns): §9 claimed filesystem atomicity across an authority boundary it cannot provide.
**Decision:** Commit point moves into the authority domain: parent completion + successor transfer = ONE CAS-committed fact; mirrors rematerialize; snapshot registration precedes prepare.
**Evidence:** spec §9 inheritance protocol; TC-8.13-8.15; DF-11/DF-13
**Next:** Hardened completion becomes crash-safe and replay-proof.
B-7:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** 'Worked fine' prose passed validation; evidence could be swapped across rows (SEC-3 provenance).
**Decision:** Rows derive solely from roadmap/conops.md; typed predicates per class; evidence binds row/script/identity/hash/provenance class.
**Evidence:** spec §11.1; TC-9.3/9.4
**Next:** The close verifier gets judgeable, bound evidence.
B-8:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Circular close binding was reproducible; successors read transcripts instead of artifacts (CB-3).
**Decision:** spine-core → evidence-index → spine-manifest with schema-forbidden reverse edges; BOOT-SPINE transitive validation.
**Evidence:** spec §11.2; TC-10.3; DF-18
**Next:** Successor sessions bootstrap from durable artifacts.
B-9:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** A version-presence response authorizes nothing; post-preflight drift rode stale probes (SEC-5, card-5716 incident).
**Decision:** Signed challenge-response + negative probes + schema_sha256 behavior fingerprints for all 9 consumed contracts; plan lint rejects fizzy-repo tasks.
**Evidence:** spec §8.2; TC-16.3; DF-3/DF-16
**Next:** Every consumed-contract transition is capability-proven.
B-10:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Registry presence can't distinguish intentional-legacy from corrupt-hardened; first-policy issuance was circular (FM-1/FM-2).
**Decision:** Authority-attested regime, epoch-zero pre-rollout immutability, historical lookup with creation-unprovable disposition, obligation-transfer-v1 as the only cross-regime path.
**Evidence:** spec §18; TC-0.4/0.10; DF-10
**Next:** Two completion regimes coexist by design, decided only by attestation.
B-11:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** The canonical order rejects its own verification transition (CON-002/FIND-002) — resume flags correctly-recorded journeys as anomalies.
**Decision:** Atomic remap to current_step:verification, idempotent phase8_subflow_migration event, post-migration write rejection, legacy journey normalization (OR-3).
**Evidence:** spec §8.1 U1 + migration block; DF-20
**Next:** The lifecycle contract and the resume checker finally agree.
C-1:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** tests-pseudo drifted v2→v7 with zero staleness warnings; renames without lineage looked clean (US-3 theme).
**Decision:** Four in-process adapters with dirty contracts + semantic fingerprints; lineage-map.json; one immutable source snapshot per run.
**Evidence:** spec §12.1; TC-13.3/13.5/13.7; DF-16/DF-19
**Next:** Every spec bump reconciles derived artifacts before dispatch.
C-2:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Round metrics and settle/freeze state lived nowhere durable; snapshot+log pairs need transactional coupling (RC-3).
**Decision:** Envelope snapshot + hash-chained event log under one StateTransaction; fail-closed resume; KPI-7 round metrics.
**Evidence:** spec §10.2; TC-12.3
**Next:** C-3 freeze and C-4 quorum read from it.
C-3:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Frozen sections re-entered every dispatch payload — cost and re-litigation; a spec edit could silently mutate settled text.
**Decision:** debate.py excludes frozen nodes (stub lines); changed frozen hash blocks dispatch until a named concern reopens.
**Evidence:** spec §10.1; TC-11.3/11.4
**Next:** Round N+1 carries exactly the volatile surface.
C-4:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** Machine agreed-flags contradicted content in 4 live instances; rounds were claimable without authority records (DD-1, SD-1).
**Decision:** Computed quorum with content-derived verdicts, Phase 4 exit gate binding rounds to authority records, mechanized press (280-char NFC floor).
**Evidence:** spec §12.2; TC-14.2/14.4; DF-15
**Next:** Convergence claims survive replay of this session's own failures.
C-5:
## Why this card exists

**Problem:** R3's gemini returned via artifact file — salvaged manually with no provenance; prompts didn't forbid it (DD-4).
**Decision:** One shared parser with strict grammar; provenance-recorded salvage through one StateTransaction; stdout-only prompt rule.
**Evidence:** spec §12.3; DF-17
**Next:** Violations become recorded evidence, never silent upgrades.
